children: Starknet is upgrading mainnet to v0.14.4, a release that enables block-sized proofs of up to 1.1B L2 gas under SNIP-36, adjusts gas weights, and removes legacy gateway endpoints. Nodes must run Pathfinder v0.24.0 or Juno v0.16.6 beforehand, and brief downtime for private transactions is expected during the rollout.

The larger proof size removes transaction computation limits, which opens the network to compute-heavy applications that previously could not fit within block constraints. Expanded usage would flow through to fee activity on Starknet, so adoption of these workloads is the variable to watch. Operators who miss the node prerequisites risk service interruptions once legacy endpoints are retired.
A major unlock for developers: applications will be able to prove logic that exceeds regular transaction limits, paying for it as a proof rather than as execution.
